figures.caption: Table S8, the simulations for the bare SPE indicate that a non-uniform stress ﬁeld exacerbates inhomogeneous Li⁺ deposition. Conversely, under the lower-concentration condition, the layered SPE system maintains highly uniform Li⁺ deposition during both plating and stripping (Fig. S13 and Table S9). Ultimately, these ﬁndings conﬁrm that the stress-homogenization strategy enabled by the layered SPE is highly robust and broadly applicable across a wide range of lithium-ion concentrations. Design and characterization of layered SPE As shown in Fig. 2a, a micro-to-macro multiscale construction strategy is employed to fabricate the layered SPE. Due to the passive properties of SiO2, it is widely used as an inorganic ﬁller in SPEs to prevent side reactions with highly reactive Li metal.
